analysis.summary: Three shots cover hotel exterior to interior. Shot 0 is a medium exterior two-shot of a young lobby boy and older concierge talking before glass entrance doors with a doorman behind. Shot 1 is a static wide interior of the grand lobby with red carpet, reception counter and arch wall, showing the doorman holding the door while staff cross. Shot 2 is a close chest-up sequence at the curved reception desk with the concierge writing and the lobby boy assisting, moving through the lobby.

shots.description: Static medium two-shot outside hotel entrance. Young lobby boy left and older concierge right in purple uniforms converse, doorman standing in glass doorway behind. Warm wood doors, transom and red carpet.

Static wide shot inside grand lobby from entrance. Doorman holds left door open, lobby boy and concierge move through. Red carpet, tile floor, palm, long reception counter and illuminated arch wall deep background.

Close tracking two-shot at reception desk area. Concierge foreground writing on paper with lobby boy beside looking on. Curved counter, arches, plants and warm sconce lighting behind. Camera stays close on upper bodies.

assumptions: Central purple figure at 3.669 (p9/f16) assumed to be same gustav as shot 0 and shot 2 based on purple jacket and age.
Far background staff behind reception counter treated as non-principal extras and not tracked.
Far background figure p5 at 11.969 assumed to be same doorman identity; face not detected so head null.
Right-walking figure p17 at 5.463 assumed to be lobbyboy; no face detection so head null.
Landmark boxes are approximate visible extents including black-bar normalization; person boxes use supplied SAM detections verbatim.
